newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE market focus on Emaar, other shares flat.
newsitem.headline: UAE market focus on Emaar, other shares flat.

text.p: All eyes were focused on the new Emaar Properties in active trade on the unofficial United Arab Emirates (UAE) stock market in the week to Thursday, with most other shares ending little changed, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index crept up some 11 points to 2,573.52 points in the week. Of the 27 traded companies, the shares of only six rose. The rest were unchanged.

Brokers said heavy trade centred on the new Emaar shares, which opened the week at 25 dirhams shortly after share allotment letters were mailed to shareholders, before slipping to a 22 dirhams close. This was still more than double the share's par value of 10 dirhams.

Among other gainers were NBAD which rose 10 dirhams to 540, and Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co, which was up 15 dirhams to 1,090. Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, gained five dirhams at 980. -- Dubai Newsroom 9714-626990
